pages.title: Day 7: Rock 'n' Roller / Day 14: Underground Vault
pages.text: Rock 'N' Roller is Day 7 of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995), an overhead boss stage. The same tune plays on Day 14, Underground Vault.

pages.title: Three bosses
pages.text: Day 14 of Vectorman, Underground Vault, has three bosses in a row, according to Sega Retro: Spider Bomber, Piranha and Monkey.
